spans.s:
मोष मोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. मुष्), a
robber, thief, plunderer; robbery, theft, stealing;
plundering, sacking, (नगर-मोष, plundering a
city); anything robbed or stolen, stolen property.
—मोष-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, one who practises theft, a
thief.
—मोषाभिदर्शन (˚ष-अभ्˚), अम्, n.
seeing or witnessing a robbery.
मोषक, अस्, m. a thief, robber.

मोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, robbing, plundering, carry-
ing off; (अम्), n. the act of robbing, plundering,
stealing, defrauding, embezzling.

मोषयित्नु, उस्, m. (fr. the Caus.), a Brāhman;
the Indian cuckoo.
मोष्टृ, टा, m. a robber, thief.
